title: Oven-Roasted Polish Almonds Flatbread
description: Crisp, cultural, crowd-pleasing flatbread originating from Poland, made with almond essence and score-fat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the warm water while mixing the dry ingredients with a wooden spoon or a stand mixer equipped with a dough hook attachment.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 2-3 equal portions, depending on the desired flatbread size.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a small bowl, mix together the almond essence and score-fat. Brush the mixture evenly onto the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Transfer the flatbreads to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, brush the tops with olive oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped parsley if desired.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for a few minutes before serving.
